title: Kenyan Cashew Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew from Kenya, made with tender beef, crunchy cashews, and a blend of aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: Kenyan stew spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at African markets or online

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces.
Add the tomatoes, Kenyan stew spice blend, salt, and black pepper.
Add the water and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours.
Stir in the cashews and continue to simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro or scallions, if desired.
